recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. The current source already preserves the approved semantics; exact Jira wording changes would be editorial and could weaken the current plural-safe phrasing.
issue_request: FHIR-14274 was a Published/Persuasive PA change request for STU3 Appointment asking to update the arrived appointment status definition and add a new checked-in status for completion of pre-encounter administrative work before the encounter may begin.
initial_application: Historical commit 68f28a21fd1626040d70a0c958e427e1368726ca (`GF#14274: Changes to the appointment-status value set`) changed the old Appointment spreadsheet from `arrived` = `Some of the patients have arrived.` to a waiting-to-be-seen definition and added `checked-in` with the requested pre-encounter definition. Later source rework preserved those terms in the current XML CodeSystem and ValueSet sources.
additional_context: Appointment is active in source/fhir.ini, and Appointment.status is required-bound to ValueSet/appointmentstatus. FHIR-3462 is earlier background for the Appointment-specific status set, while FHIR-18824 is a later separate waitlist addition already represented on the combined branch. Exact-key Zulip and Confluence searches found no conflicting community guidance.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The active CodeSystem has `arrived` defined as `The patient/patients has/have arrived and is/are waiting to be seen.` and has `checked-in` defined as `When checked in, all pre-encounter administrative work is complete, and the encounter may begin. (where multiple patients are involved, they are all present).` The required-bound value set includes that CodeSystem, and Appointment.status lists checked-in in its short code list.
